title: Custom Keywords

story.introduction:
Day 8 on planet Syntax-IV. Settings are configured, but MENTOR-9 notices repeated code patterns.

"PROTO-7, you're writing the same diagnostic steps over and over. Time to learn custom keywords - reusable procedures that make your tests cleaner and more maintainable."

"The *** Keywords *** section is where you build your own diagnostic library."
story.context: Custom keywords are user-defined procedures that encapsulate common test operations. They promote code reuse, improve readability, and make tests easier to maintain.

learningObjectives: Create simple custom keywords without arguments
Build keywords with arguments for flexibility
Return values from keywords using RETURN statement
